page.layout: One photographed book spine on a black background. No printed text block. Left to right: a white paper label with a handwritten number, a label reading "Judæorum et Aram..." (partly legible), a brown label reading "...IMAGIN... IST... SAMUEL" (partly legible), a faint "20" in pencil, and two orange shelf-mark labels. The digitiser's credit and shelf mark below the spine are excluded.
page.notes: Spine of the bound volume, not a printed page. Only the spine lettering is visible and it is partly worn: "Judæorum" and "et Aram" on the left label, and fragments such as "IMAGIN" and "SAMUEL" on the brown label. Excluded as not printed text: the handwritten and paper shelf-mark labels (36, G, 23), the pencilled "20", and the digitiser's credit line (Early European Books, ProQuest; Koninklijke Bibliotheek, Den Haag; 36 G 23 [1]).
